{{Quote|Jabba's Game Plaza is waitin' for you! Go back and earn lots of credits so you can pay them to me when you buy your ship parts! Hm hm.|Watto to the spacer|<ref name="JGG">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
An '''unidentified spacer''' from another [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] traveled through the [[Dragon's Spine (asteroid field)|Dragon's Spine]], an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in orbit around the barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at some point before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The spacer collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and made a forced landing on the planet. Stranded on Tatooine with [[Unidentified starship (marooned spacer)|their]] damaged [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the spacer met [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], a local [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] junk dealer, who offered to provide his visitor with spare parts for [[Currency/Legends|money]]. The marooned spacer then participated in games at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Game Plaza|Game Plaza]] until they earned enough [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi credits]] to buy new ship parts. Having successfully repaired their spacecraft, the spacer left Tatooine for good.

==Biography==
===Stranded on Tatooine===
[[File:Spacer_crashing_on_Tatooine.png|thumb|250px|The spacer's ship careening out of control]]
{{Quote|Eh, so you had a bit of a rough landing, I think. Too bad for you, eh? New ships don't come cheap.|Watto to the spacer|<ref name="JGG" />}}
While it was often thought that a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Circumferential hyperspace barrier|disturbance]] beyond the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] rendered intergalactic travel impossible,<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> counter examples occurred in recorded history.<ref name="JGG" /> At some point before the events of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> one such [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] traveling aboard a [[Unidentified starship (marooned spacer)|starship]] with [[Color/Legends|crimson]] markings<ref name="JGG" /> reached the [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> As that individual was flying through the [[Dragon's Spine (asteroid field)|Dragon's Spine]], the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] surrounding the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] collided with one of the asteroids. The damaged vessel, spinning out of control, crashed onto the [[Star/Legends|sun]]-scorched world, leaving its pilot stranded. Committed to finding help, the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] then headed to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], where a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] merchant named [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] had a [[Wald's Parts|shop]]. Eager to turn the newcomer into a [[Currency/Legends|paying]] customer, Watto assured the spacer he could provide high-quality ship parts to mend the damaged ship. The foreigner was told they could earn [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi credits]] if they entered [[Jabba's Game Plaza]], a gaming venue organized by the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. In order to have the best chance of success, the spacer was even lent a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] helper named [[Z-P70]], one of the Toydarian's robotic assistants. Watto also provided the spacer with a checklist showing which parts were needed to rebuild the ship and which ones were available in his shop.<ref name="JGG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}

===Sojourn in Mos Espa===
[[File:JabbasGamePlaza-SWMath.png|thumb|left|200px|The spacer entered Jabba's gaming venue.]]
{{Quote|I suggest you pay a visit to Jabba's Game Plaza. You could win some credits if you're very, very lucky.|Watto|<ref name="JGG" />}}
At the Game Plaza, the stranded spacer entered four gaming activities in which they played for money against local celebrities. The spacer faced the famous [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], challenging him to his very own game of "[[Dueling Dice]]." Another player was [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]], who hosted a giant snakes and ladders game known as "[[Ratts Race]]." Under a yellow and green tent was [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]], with his [[Digotto]] gaming booth. The stranger even played the [[Holochex]] with Jabba the Hutt himself, beating the crime lord at his own game. Gradually, the spacer raised enough money to purchase the required spare parts rom Watto. However, the last required component, a [[StarMark III Hyperdrive|StarMark III]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], was still too expansive for the offworlder to afford with their gains. As the ship was only equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]], it could merely travel at a fraction below [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. Without a hyperdrive unit, the stranger would never be able to return to their galaxy at a reasonable speed. The spacer then accepted to work for Watto, collecting space junk in the nearby asteroid field. Eventually, the damaged starship was fully repaired in the Toydarian's [[Watto's hangar|private]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and the spacer left Tatooine for good.<ref name="JGG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ohla ta ba kha! You are good! I demand you play again.|Jabba the Hutt, upon losing a game of Holochex|<ref name="JGG" />}}
The spacer was skilled at strategy game and other mind sports. Jabba the Hutt himself said the stranger had "the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of a Hutt,"<ref name="JGG" /> a real compliment since Hutts considered themselves superior to most other life-forms in the galaxy.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> The stranger also managed to gain the respect of the other gaming hosts. In spite of their extra-galactic origins, the spacer understood [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] well enough to barter with Watto and the other players at Jabba's Game Plaza.<ref name="JGG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Embark on an exciting adventure with intriguing characters like Sebulba, Jabba the Hutt and more. Use your wits, skills and math smarts to outsmart your opponent in numerous challenging math games.|Lucas Learning game demo|<ref name="JGG" />}}
In ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'', an educational video game released by [[Lucas Learning]] in [[2000]], the player assumed the role of a marooned spacer. The character's [[Gender/Legends|gender]], [[Species/Legends|species]] and name were never specified in-game, so the player could give the character a name of their liking.<ref name="JGG" /> Unlike other game characters&mdash;like [[Rookie One]] from ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''<ref name="Rebel Assault manual">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' manual (PC)</ref> or [[Jaden Korr]] from ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>&mdash;this spacer has not been reused or given a proper canonical identity in later works.
